description: Multishot arrows from the same attack can hit the same target and have an increased chance to stun enemies, but {Multishot} deals significantly less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Projectiles Can Hit The Same Target
Hitting Boss or Rare triggers Anguish

description:
The spores from {Seeds} now heal you and your allies. 

This effect is tripled for minions.
You have additional health and your ward decays more slowly.

stats.statName: Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Surge

description: Upheaval critical strikes deal more damage.
{Contempt} stacks last for a duration after you stop channelling Drain Life.
Warcry now pulls enemies instead of knocking them back.

Whenever you directly cast an {Invocation} you blink to the target location first, but Runic Invocation now has a cooldown. 

{Invocations} cast this way automatically targets a random nearby enemy.

Runic Invocation gains the {Traversal} tag.
You have increased movement speed, attack speed, and dodge rating.
Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to grant you mana.
Your and your minions' hits have a chance to poison.

stats.statName: Chance To Summon A Vine On Kill

description:
Maul and Rampage's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Armor Shred and bleed chance from all sources is converted to shock and effects related to armor shred or bleed now depend on shock instead for Maul and Rampage.

stats.statName: Armor Shred And Bleed -> Shock Chance

description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Heo Rune} have a chance to chill enemies and have a higher chance to freeze them.

stats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier With Heo Rune

description:
If you have at least 3 stacks of {Oil Coating} you are granted additional fire penetration.

This effect is doubled for ignites inflicted by Cinder Strike.

Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per 2 Attunement.

All the melee strikes have a higher chance to freeze enemies.
When you jump backwards in time, {Devouring Orb} recovers some of its cooldown scaling with the amount of {Devouring Orbs} that expired after jumping forwards in time.
You can consume [1] additional {Elemental Arrow} with each bow attack. If you consume 3 arrows with a single attack it has 200% additional shock and ignite chance

stats.statName: Elemental Arrow consumed per bow attack
Shock and Ignite chance when consuming 3 Arrows

description: You have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura} while channeling Disintegrate.

Shield Bash causes your next melee or throwing attack to have additional ignite chance and critical strike chance. Excludes channelled skills.

This effect is significantly reduced if Shield Bash does not have a cooldown.

Ghostflames's base necrotic and fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic or fire damage.

Damned and ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second.

Ghostflame now drains a portion of your health each second.

Swaps Ghostflames's {Necrotic} and {Fire} tags for a {Physical} tag.
Fireball has increased cast speed and deals more damage for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer fires extra projectiles.
When directly using Net you now throw a {Smoke Bomb} after jumping.
You grant other nearby allies {Haste} at the end of the charge for a short duration based on distance traveled, up to a maximum.
Fire damage provided by Symbols is converted to void damage. Each Symbol now grants 15% increased void damage, but no longer increases health regeneration.

stats.statName: Increased Void Damage Per Active Symbol
Symbols Do Not Increase Health Regen

description: Summon a decoy.

You now fear nearby enemies for a short duration when you exit Profane Veil. Additionally, Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared or slowed enemies for the same duration.
Echoes you discover on your echo web that would have had {Gold} rewards have a different random reward instead.
Multishot's critical strikes deal more damage.

Dread Shade now attaches to enemies instead, still buffing your minions, but Dread Shade now has a duration, and this duration cannot be increased.

This does not buff or drain the health of enemies.
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} restores significantly more health to minions.
Ice Barrage instantly fires 5 ice shards in a cone.
Reduces Lightning Blast's channel cost if Lightning Blast cannot chain.

stats.statName: Mana Cost Per Second if Lightning Blast Cannot Chain

description: Bladestorm has additional critical strike chance.

While your Disintegrate is at tier 3 you have a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} and {Spark Charges} on enemies in the beam each second while channeling.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, the {Spark Charges} are converted to {Spreading Flames}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, the {Spreading Flames} is converted to {Spark Charges}.

During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first {Rune}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least one rune for this effect to occur.
{Divine Flare} now has a chance to gain a Symbol on kill or when hitting a boss or rare enemy.
When you attempt to use Serpent Strike against a target that is slightly out of range you will lunge forwards before attacking.

stats.statName: Lunge if Slightly Out of Range

description: Whenever you pass through a {Frost Wall} during Flame Rush it causes the explosion to deal damage in a much larger area and its chance to critically hit is doubled.

When you directly cast Flame Reave and consume {Rhythm of Fire}, you cast {Elemental Nova} with more area and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect consumes a percentage of Elemental Nova's mana cost.

stats.statName: Rhythm of Fire Casts Elemental Nova

description: You have increased mana and mana regen and your bow attacks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of their mana cost.
Aura of Decay has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies every second. A percentage of your chance to shred armor on hit also contributes to this chance per second.

stats.statName: Percent of Armor Shred Chance on Hit Contribution

description: Ring of Shields is cast at your target location instead, but Shields no longer follow you. Shields have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and last much longer.

Flame Reave hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}.

Flame Reave deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

When you use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Armor} for 6 seconds up to a maximum amount of stacks, granting you additional armor and endurance threshold per stack of Attunement.

stats.statName: Endurance Threshold Per Attunement Per Stack

description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

Rive's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Swaps Rive's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag. 

Additionally, your chance to {Echo} with Rive is doubled.

Frost Wall now casts {Runebolt} in the original target direction the Wall was cast. The element of the bolts match the element of the Wall, regardless of {Runebolt's} tree.

This effect consumes 2 mana per projectile and does not cast if you are at negative mana.
Umbral Blades now throw towards a fixed distance in front of you, and you have increased attack speed with Umbral Blades.

When you proc {Arrowstorm} you gain stacks of {Silver Shroud}. Silver Shroud is a buff that gives you 100% chance to dodge the next hit. Dodging a hit with Silver Shroud consumes all stacks, granting you 100 ward per stack.
Whenever the Falcon hits an enemy with {Falcon Strikes} it {Marks} them. Your next hit against a {Marked} target deals more damage and consumes the {Mark}.
Flame Ward grants additional ward.

Tornados' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Void Cleave has a shorter cooldown.
Ballista now has shields in front of it.
When you directly cast Smite, you appear at Smite's targeted location, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies. Smite costs more mana, has a cooldown, and counts as a {Traversal} skill.
Net's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

The benefits from the {Vampiric Pool} and {Apocalypse} nodes now also trigger when you kill enemies with Profane Veil.

The limit from {Vampiric Pool} remains the same.
Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but your Sabertooth can no longer leap.
{Cemeteries} are more common on your echo web.

When your Falcon kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy it restores health and mana to you based on your total attributes. This effect can occur from hits a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Lightning Blast} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Lightning Blast's mana cost.

stats.statName: Lightning Blast on Kill or Rare or Boss Hit

description:
Flame Ward is converted to Cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, granting it a freeze rate, and converts any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to cold and grants it a Freeze Rate.

stats.statName: Fire Aura Freeze Rate Per Second

description: Flame Ward grants additional ward, but has a shorter duration.
While spinning, you and your allies are healed each second within Warpath's area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

{Thunder Tempest} shocks enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.
{Arena} echoes are more common on your echo web.
Soul Feast costs less mana and has a chance based on your current mana to draw back {Greater Soul Fragments}, which grant more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Greater Fragment Chance per 10 Current Mana

description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that causes enemies to bleed.

While spinning, you cast {Abyssal Echoes} every 5 seconds.

This consumes Abyssal Echoes' mana cost.
Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also grants your next bow attack increased damage over time.
You unleash waves of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of your maximum mana to nearby enemies each second while channeling.
Shield Bash has added melee damage based on your block effectiveness.
The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy necrotic resistance.
While you have at least 1 stack of Firebrand, your next cast of {Lightning Blast} will consume all stacks to chain additional times per stack consumed.

stats.statName: Lightning Blast Chains per Firebrand Stack Consumed

description: Flame Reave returns to you. This can hit the same enemy again.

Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy with Flame Rush, instead of gaining ward per stack of ignite on the enemy and consuming your ignite stacks without dealing damage, you lose 12 ward per stack of ignite and the ignite stacks instantly deal their remaining damage on the enemy.

If you do not have enough ward for this effect, a percentage of your remaining health is consumed instead, up to a maximum. Ignite stacks consumed this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per point of intelligence.

stats.statName: % Of Current Health Consumed Per Ignite Without Ward

description:
{Frigid Tempest} chills on enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies.
You have increased movement speed with a dagger equipped, more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with an axe equipped, and additional ward per second with a catalyst equipped.

stats.statName: Increased Movement Speed With A Dagger
Ward Per Second With A Catalyst

description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area, but Zombies no longer move.
Shield Bash now also slows enemies.
Lethal Mirage has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and bleed inflicted by Lethal Mirage has additional Physical Penetration.
Upheaval hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies and it penetrates enemy physical resistance, but travels a shorter distance.
Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased ward retention.

Your {Tombs of the Erased} have increased packsize.
Your {Arena} echoes have increased packsize.
Your {Arena} echoes drop {Memory Amber} on completion.
You regain mana and a portion of your missing health when you directly use {Rive}, {Vengeance}, {Smite}, or {Multistrike}.
Ignited inflicted by Infernal Shade has additional Fire Penetration
Your abomination's hits leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

While transformed and you use any melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast each {Tempest} of a matching damage type.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tempest Strike's mana cost.
Converts {Fire Arrow} into {Ice Arrow}, converting its base fire damage to cold damage. Ignite chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Ice Arrow.

stats.statName: Ignite -> Frostbite Chance for Ice Arrow

description: Rive's first strike consumes mana to release a wave of energy that passes through enemies.
Casting Static Orb sends out smaller orbs in a cone in front of you. These small orbs can hit the same target as the large orb, but cannot explode and do not pull.

You now summon a {Deathchill Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

The base physical damage of Deathchill Golems' melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not increases to minion physical damage. Death Chill Golems' melee attacks gain a Freeze Rate equal to twice their base damage.

Deathchill Golem also casts Freezing Grasp, a spell that deals cold damage and has high freeze rate. Bosses cannot be frozen by this.
Anomaly no longer sends enemies foward in time. Effects that would be triggered when enemies return to the present are instead triggered immediately.

stats.statName: No Longer Sends Enemies Forward In Time

description: {Consecrated Ground} restores more health, but has a shorter duration.
When you use Ice Thorns you gain a stack of {Farwood Heart} for 4 seconds, a buff that grants 25% increased cold damage and +40% freeze rate multiplier.

A {Shadow Falcon} takes your Falcon's place, that uses Dive Bomb. Your Falcon is able to attack and use other abilities during this.
If you do not have an active Falcon, Dive Bomb will scale with your stats instead.

When fully charged, Smelter's Wrath leaves behind a {Burning Patch} for 6 seconds which ignites all enemies who stand in it twice per second.

Smelter's Wrath costs additional mana.
While spinning, you gain mana every three seconds while wielding a two handed weapon.
After the initial {Wing Burst} your Falcon continues releasing {Featherstorm} at the target location for 5 seconds.
Javelin gains physical and lightning penetration for each second you have been standing still up to a maximum duration.
Flame Ward's retaliation hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
When you directly cast Runic Invocation, the next non-channelled elemental spell you cast penetrates enemy elemental resistance and deals damage in a larger area.

Net now throws a trap that releases a net at a nearby enemy when it triggers.

You can have a maximum of 6 Net Traps active at once and they last up to 30 seconds.

stats.statName: Shared Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits

description:
Javelin is now a combo ability, the first part throws down the {Battle Standard} and the second part causes you to {Dash} to the flag.

Javelin's cooldown is now longer.
When used with a melee weapon Puncture has increased range.
Puncture has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
Bladestorms gain more movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 1 second if you {Shift} through any part of the Bladestorm.
Your critical strikes deal more damage for each passive point you have invested in the Void Knight tree.

stats.statName: Critical Multiplier Per Point Spent In Void Knight

description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now consumes your mana.

If no nearby enemies are cursed when you directly cast Soul Feast, then {Bone Curse} is cast at nearby enemies.

Each cast consumes 110% of Bone Curse's mana cost per cast.
Whenever you would summon a {Forged Weapon} from any source, you instead gain a stack of Scrap Metal. Each stack grants more armour and more damage with Rive (multiplicative with other modifiers).
You gain additional dodge rating per intelligence while channeling Ghostflame, as well as more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channeling Ghostflame.

stats.statName: Dodge Rating per Intelligence while Channeling

description:
Harvest's base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Harvest now gains bleed chance per point of intelligence. Harvest's added damage per dexterity scaling is now added physical melee damage.

Swaps Harvest's {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.
Shadow Rend has additional critical strike multiplier, and additional chance to blind enemies on hit.
Small boulders have a chance to be replaced by large boulders.
Profane Veil costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Infernal Shade gains 15% fire penetration each second that it is unattached to a target.
Warcry knocks enemies further back.
Flay inflicts {Exposed Flesh} on hit, a Curse which reduces cold resistance and armor, and increases the target's chance to be frozen.
If you haven't cast Frost Wall in the past 15 seconds, it has no mana cost and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to chill enemies. 

Additionally, Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to deal double hit damage to chilled enemies.

stats.statName: Chance for Double Hit Damage against Chilled

description: Electrify applied by Smite has increased duration and additional Lightning Penetration
Warcry now has a cooldown of 5 seconds which cannot be reduced by stunning or freezing enemies, but Warcry no longer has a guaranteed stun, freeze, or fear.
Your melee hits apply an additional stack of {Fiery Inquisition} and if you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals damage in an increased area.
Your bear's basic attack releases a {Thorn Burst}, a spell that deals physical damage around the bear.
Anomaly applies additional stacks of ignite.
Firebrand can have more maximum stacks and deals more damage per stack, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Consuming stacks of {Aerial Assault} now grants you {Haste} and Frenzy for a short duration per stack consumed.
Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but also applies poison to yourself more frequently.
{Furnace} has a chance to ignite enemies each second.
Runebolt has a chance to shoot additional projectiles in a volley in front of you.
Death Seal now targets only minions.
Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less Poison Resistance.
Lethal Mirage penetrates enemy physical resistance.
Puncture has a chance to poison on hit.
Aftershocks deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and last longer.
Being healed by Smite grants you or your allies increased health and mana regeneration for 4 seconds (does not stack).
Acid Flask has increased poison duration.

When you directly use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Shattering} up to a maximum, causing your next {Fury Leap} or {Earthquake} to consume all stacks to gain additional physical penetration and increased area per stack consumed.

stats.statName: Buff To Next Fury Leap Or Earthquake

description: You have additional attunement. You and your minions penetrate enemy physical, cold, and lightning resistances.

After directly using Roar, Human Form is now replaced with {Swarm Call}, which summons a {Locust} for each nearby stunned enemy up to 6 and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.
While affected by Frenzy Totem, you revive downed companions faster.
Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you depart. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.
Shurikens are now thrown at enemies all around you rather than in a cone in front of you.
When enemies return to the present, enemies within the area of Anomaly's original cast are also time locked for 2 seconds.

stats.statName: Nearby Enemies Afflicted With Time Lock On Return

description: Judgement's melee attack heals you and nearby allied players for each enemy it hits. This healing is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.
Heartseeker has additional charges.
You have additional melee damage and spell damage.
When you heal a minion at low life, you have a chance to summon a murder of 3 crows.

stats.statName: Chance To Summon 3 Crows On Low Life Minion Heal

description: {Forged Weapons} have a much shorter duration, but deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and explode when they expire, dealing fire and physical damage to nearby enemies.
When you directly use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain mana, but bow attacks cost more mana.
{Time Lock} lasts longer.
Multishot has increased critical strike chance.
The explosion has a chance to poison enemies.
Multishot hits in a wider cone.
Place a {Woven Echo} to imprint it in this slot for it to have a chance to spawn on your echo web when a new echo is generated.
When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Sabertooth} or {Raptor} companions, you are both granted a chance to cause enemies to bleed with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.
You have a chance to cause bleeding with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.
Dancing Strikes has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 2 seconds on use.

Earthquake's base damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Additionally, armor shred chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.
Snap Freeze knocks enemies back.

stats.statName: Ward Per Second Per 10 Max Mana

description: After landing, all your active {Ballistas} prioritize targets around you, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Intelligence, and gain increased attack speed.

You have a chance to gain haste for 2 seconds when you or your {Falcon} hits an enemy.

Additionally, you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have haste.
When you summon Frenzy Totem you gain a temporary buff that grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed, but also increases the damage you take.
{Aspect of the Shark} is more effective and lasts longer.

stats.statName: Increased Aspect Of The Shark Duration

description: You deal increased physical damage and have a chance to inflict bleed on hit with melee and throwing attacks.
You have increased drop rate of {Memory Amber} in your echoes.

Your bear has more health regeneration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

While you have an active bear companion, you have more health regeneration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Health Regen for You with Active Bear

description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating for a short duration on use.
Chaos Bolts deals more damage and its hits deal more damage to {Cursed} enemies (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Storm Bolt When Hit

description: Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Each stack of Maelstrom grants you an increased chance to stun enemies.

stats.statName: Global Increased Stun Chance Per Stack

description:
When you jump backwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become younger.

This causes them to expire later, and each orb can only benefit from this once.

You now summon {Volatile Zombies} when you exit Profane Veil equal to the number of minions consumed up to a maximum from the {Vampiric Pool} node.

{Zombies} summoned deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area per Intelligence.
Cinder Strike has a chance to blind enemies while using a bow and a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies while using a melee weapon.
You now heal allies and cleanse negative ailments on allies you Lunge to. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.
Storm Crows have increased cast speed, movement speed and more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Lightning Blast has a chance to double cast, and Lightning Blast critical strikes deal more damage.

Lightning Blast cannot double cast if it is channelled or cast by another skill.
Healing hands deals additional spell damage based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.

stats.statName: Spell Damage per 20% increased Healing Effectiveness

description: {Passive:} Ignites you inflict last longer (doubled while active).
Discharge now has a chance to stun enemies, with a higher chance based the number of charges you have.
Shadow Rend no longer moves you. The manifested shadow dashes forward 5 meters in the targeted direction before attacking, and will choose a target within range upon arriving.
You cannot be stunned if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

While spinning, you deal increased void damage and you have a chance each second to create an {Echo} at a recent location that uses Warpath on the spot for 2 seconds. This chance is equal to twice your chance for skills to echo.

You can only create a Warpath echo if you have been spinning for at least 2 seconds and have travelled at least 4 metres in the past 2 seconds.
{Featherstorm} now has a chance each second to drop a {Black Arrow}.

Directly using Flay consumes a percentage of your current health and ward. Flay gains additional melee damage per 30 health consumed and additional spell damage per 30 ward consumed by this effect, up to a limited amount of each.

stats.statName: Percent of Current Health and Ward Consumed

description:
If you have positive mana, Rive's second strike pulls enemies.

Additionally, Rive's hits slow enemies.

Manifested Armor gains the ability to use {Whirlwind Strike}, a spinning attack which hits all nearby enemies multiple times and travels a short distance. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.
When a target is killed by Drain Life, you chill enemies in an area around them for a duration.
Erasing Strike no longer has a cooldown, but it deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

{Passive:} You have a chance to chill enemies with melee attacks, and you gain a chance to inflict frostbite on enemies based on your chill chance.

{Active:} Both of these effects are doubled.

stats.statName: Percent of Chill Chance gained as Frostbite Chance

description: Runic Invocation has increased cast speed and when directly casting an {Invocation} you gain ward equal to a portion of your current mana.
You and your minions have a chance to chill on hit, a higher chance to freeze enemies and additional cold resistance.
Dancing Strikes deals damage in a larger area.
Storm Totem hits deal more damage to shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
You have additional strength
Frostbite, chill, slow, ignite, and shock inflicted by Frost Claw last longer.
Dancing Strikes has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies casts {Bone Curse} at their location.

This effect has a 6 second cooldown.
Soul Feast's hits have a chance to poison enemies on hit.
You leave behind a {Bone Minion}, which is a temporary melee minion, when you use Transplant, but your previous body no longer detonates. Other detonations still behave normally.
Serpent Strike hits have a chance to inflict {Serpent Venom}, an ailment that deals poison damage over time and prevents enemies from landing critical strikes. It lasts 3 seconds and cannot stack.
The Decoy has increased ignite frequency.
You are granted increased cast speed each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.
Activating Enchant Weapon cleanses negative ailments.
You have additional vitality and deal increased damage over time.

stats.statName: More Bleed Damage per 10 Poisons on Enemy, up to 20%
More Poison Damage per 10 Bleeds on Enemy, up to 20%

description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Wind Tempest}, but it does not remove the physical strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.
Picking up a {Black Arrow} resets the combo of {Cinder Strike}.
Your spells and attacks deal additional void damage.
While Arcane Ascendance is active, each hit you take increases your spell damage and cast speed, but drains your mana.
The {Battle Standard} now lasts longer, but is still limited to one standard.
You have additional dexterity and increased movement speed.
Ice Thorns releases additional thorns, but costs more mana.
You have additional poison penetration and bow attacks have additional chance to poison on hit.
Flame Ward can store an additional charge, allowing you to use it twice before it goes on cooldown.

Every 10 seconds Storm Crows cast {Wisdom of the Storm} on its nearest ally, granting it {Aspect of the Crow}. 

This effect has 50% reduced duration on minions.

stats.statName: Wisdom of the Storm On Allies

description:
Healing Hands is converted into a melee attack that hits in a wide arc in front of you. It now scales with melee damage instead of spell damage and effects on this tree that granted spell damage now grant melee damage instead.

Healing Hands still heals you, as well as allies within its area of affect.
The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.
Explosive Trap costs less mana and it has increased throwing attack speed.
Shifting heals you. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

You cast {Entangling Roots} when you Swarm Strike and the {Locust Swarm} occurs above the roots, rather than around you, causing them to be stationary.

The duration and area of the {Locust Swarm} matches Entangling Roots.
When Soul Feast hits an enemy {Cursed} with {Spirit Plague}, {Decrepify}, {Marked for Death}, or {Penance} it spreads those {Cursed} from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.
Lightning Blasts from {Overload} have additional critical strike chance and a chance to chain additional times.
Improves Rive's base critical strike chance. This bonus is doubled for Rive's third strike.

stats.statName: First And Second Strike Base Crit Chance

description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Seeds now burst when you hit them with {Upheaval} and deal damage in a larger area when detonated this way.
Boss objective echoes have a chance to contain two bosses instead of one. They deal more damage, have more health, and drop an additional unique item when slain.
Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage per stack of bleed on the enemy, up to a maximum. This does not affect ailment damage.
Each {Umbral Blade} thrown into a Bladestorm is destroyed upon landing to grant the Bladestorm more damage and radius (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for 4 seconds, up to 40 stacks.
You and your minions have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and you have increased mana regeneration.
{Future Strike} is applied to all enemies hit by Anomaly.
Hail of Arrows now also shoots a {Barrage of Arrows} on use dealing bow physical damage, but costs more mana. This does not scale with damage over time.
{Axe Volley} hits deal more hit damage per point of Dexterity.

stats.statName: Axe Volley Hit Damage per Dexterity

description: The smoke cloud is converted to a poison cloud causing enemies to be poisoned each second, but no longer inflicts {Frailty}.

description: Focus has increased healing effectiveness per point of intelligence.
Critical strikes restore health. The amount of health gained is increased by Dexterity.
Puncture has a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.
Teleport creates additional {Mirror Images} on arrival. Mirror images have a shorter duration.
Skeletons deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger, but you can only summon half as many as you could before (rounded up).
Skeletons are able to use their abilities more frequently, and {Bone Armor} cast by Skeletons lasts longer.
Discharge has a significantly higher range, but can only hit enemies within a 90 degree arc.
Frost Wall now cleanses negative ailments on you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.
Recalling the blades now sends each blade toward a different nearby enemy instead of to you, but recalled blades no longer pierce.

When you hit an enemy with Harvest both you and the enemy are inflicted with bleed. Bleed stacks on enemies inflicted by Harvest have additional Physical Penetration.

The self-inflicted bleed does not scale with your stats.
Entangling Roots damage accelerates over time, dealing more damage each second (multiplicative with other modifiers).
You now also have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you directly cast Thorn Shield.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Maelstrom On Thorn Shield

description: Your area skills have increased area, and when you directly use an area skill and hit an enemy you gain ward per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.

stats.statName: Ward Per Rune On Area Skill Use And Hit

description: You backflip away from target direction when you use Shurikens, but it now has a cooldown.
When you directly cast Maelstrom, you have a chance to also cast Tornado. This consumes a percentage of Tornado's mana cost.

stats.statName: Chance for Tornado on Direct Cast
Percent of Tornado Mana Cost Consumed

description: When any of your minions targeted by Dread Shade dies, it casts {Sacrifice} on additional minions, with each cast consuming mana equal to Sacrifice's mana cost.
The {Force Waves} travel further.
You gain the {Shapeshifter} buff for a limited duration when you transform, granting you increased armor and damage.
While in Reaper Form, you deal additional necrotic damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.
{Void Cleave} consumes all stacks of Armament to gain more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased area per stack consumed.

You are limited to a single companion.

Your companion is larger and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
You gain ward when entering Reaper Form.
Holy Aura's active duration lasts longer, but Holy Aura's cooldown lasts longer and its passive is disabled during its cooldown.
Storm Crows have additional dodge chance and increased dodge chance.
{Primal Serpents} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional armour
You are less likely to be stunned, you have a higher chance to block hits and you take less damage from hits that you block.
Each stack of {Rhythm} also grants 5% global more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dancing Strikes cost more mana.
Convert the health gain from the {Healing Gust} node to ward at half the effect.
{Unseen Strike} slows enemies it hits.
You have a higher endurance threshold and you and your minions have additional physical resistance.
Sigils of Hope is cast instantly, but costs more mana and gains a cooldown.
Aftershocks blind enemies within their area of effect.
Cinder Strike deals increased fire damage over time per point of Dexterity.
Directly using Javelin causes your next melee attack to costs less mana.
{Black Arrows} are summoned more frequently. This does not cause more arrows to be summoned and also causes {Dark Quiver} to have a shorter duration.

Transplant explosions instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

Bone Curse becomes a toggled aura which surrounds you, but it has reduced area and drains your mana over time. You are also inflicted with Bone Curse.

This is not compatible with the {Oppressive Gaze} and {Illusion of Pain} nodes.
{Fissure} instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (percentage of their maximum health).
You travel further with Surge.
You are invulnerable while Lunging.
When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Sacrifice} on another nearby minion. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost.

stats.statName: Percent of Sacrifice Mana Cost Consumed

description:
Your echoes have a high chance to spawn a {Champion}.

Additionally, {Champions} have a chance to drop additional exalted items in your echoes.
{Vomit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Rive's second strike has a chance to ignite enemies.
The stun inflicted by {Stagger} lasts longer and Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.
When used on a minion, Death Seal also grants it more damage and critical strike chance (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to stun enemies.
Using a Black Arrow grants your next {Heartseeker} additional {Recurve} chance.
{Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance while in its area.
You gain ward when Firebrand hits at least one enemy.
Blind chance from all sources is converted to {Critical Vulnerability} chance for Cinder Strike.
You have a global chance to cause enemies to bleed per stack of {Rhythm}.
Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).
You gain ward when you activate Arcane Ascendance.
Shield Throw deals additional throwing fire damage and penetrate enemy fire resistance.
Ghostflame now deals damage in a full circle around you, but it has a higher channel cost.
Spirit Plague has additional spell necrotic damage for each point of Intelligence

If you have 3 {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} when you create a {Runestone}, the {Runes} are consumed to instead create an {Imbued Runestone} that fires three bolts. An {Imbued Runestone's} explosion has 100% more area of effect and damage.

This effect has a 20 second cooldown. When you cast {Runic Invocation} the remaining cooldown is reduced by 20% per {Rune} in the {Invocation}.

stats.statName: Increased damage taken from nearby enemies

description: Smite has a chance to {Electrify} on hit.

Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) per amount of missing mana. This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

stats.statName: More Expansion Speed Per 3 Missing Mana

description: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Cursed} enemies while in Profane Veil.
The next damaging non-channelled skill you use after Shifting is always a critical strike.

stats.statName: Always Crit With Next Non-Channelled Skill

description:
You now summon a {Blood Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

Blood Golems can also cast {Sanguine Orb}, a spell that deals physical damage to nearby enemies over 2 seconds.
Flame Ward grants ward over time while active.
You have increased armor if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).
Maelstrom has a chance to chill enemies each second.
Manifested Armor deals additional melee and spell fire damage as well as more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Avalanche deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Warcry costs less mana and {Haste} gained from {Hastily Advance} lasts longer.

nodeName: In the Eye of the Storm
description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Maelstrom}.
Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and Lightning Blast now only chains to targets in front of you.
Blood Eruption consumes mana to release a Wandering Spirit. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.
Your Spriggan can now cast {Ensnaring Roots}, a wave of roots deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.
Smite heals allies for more health.
Holy Aura grants you and your allies increasing throwing attack speed and a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second on hit.
Tempest Strike penetrates enemy resistances per your uncapped resistances corresponding to a specific type.
A bow or melee skill that performs 3 rapid attacks.
You regain health and {Rage} on kill or when you hit a rare or boss enemy.

Storm Totem casts {Lightning Nova} when it dies.

stats.statName: Less Hit Damage To Far Away Targets

Whenever you directly cast Thorn Shield, you also cast Eterra's Blessing on the same target.

Consumes Eterra's Blessing's mana cost as rage.

Glyph of Dominion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.
{Thorn Burst} and Spirit Thorn hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

These effects scale with the amount of projectiles Chaos Bolts would have shot.

Your Scorpion casts {Acid Lob}, a ranged spell that explodes on impact, poisoning enemies and reducing their armor. Acid Lob has a 6 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Melee Damage vs 12 stacks of Time Rot

Channelling Assemble Abomination now consumes two minions at a time.
The {Runic Detonations} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you are facing away from the wall when the detonations occur.

Storm Totem hits have a chance to chill enemies.
You can control more {Wraiths} at once.
{Time Wave} deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, and increases to Anomaly's area also affect Time Wave.

Endurance Threshold Per 2% Uncapped Elemental Resistance

Increased Throwing Attack Speed while Dual Wielding

You gain the {Frenzy} buff, while you are able to jump backwards in time.

stats.statName: Frenzy While Able To Jump Back

Rooted enemies are also blinded.

Frost Claw's projectiles are faster and it costs less mana.

Runebolt gains additional effects for each unique {Rune} you have. Multiple {Runes} of the same type does not stack the effect.

{Rah Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to ignite enemies.
{Gon Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to shock enemies.
{Heo Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on enemies.

stats.statName: Bleed Chance -> Bleed Chance per second

Multishot arrows pierce enemies (continue through enemies hit) up to a limit.
You have additional health and whenever you receive a glancing blow you recover health.

Your abomination can no longer absorb {Summoned Skeletons}.

Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Vanguards, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

stats.statName: Chance To Summon 3 Crows On Minion Heal

While you are using a shield you have additional armor.
